//! @generated — encoder PNG tanpa dependency. Backend hanya menghasilkan
//! `Frame`; encoding dilakukan di sini, terpisah dari renderer mana pun.

use crate::core::Frame;

pub fn encode(frame: &Frame) -> Vec<u8> {
    let width = frame.width();
    let height = frame.height();
    let mut raw = Vec::with_capacity(height * (width * 4 + 1));
    for row in frame.pixels.chunks(width * 4) {
        raw.push(0); // filter: none
        raw.extend_from_slice(row);
    }
    let mut png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".to_vec();
    chunk(&mut png, b"IHDR", &ihdr(width, height));
    chunk(&mut png, b"IDAT", &stored_deflate(&raw));
    chunk(&mut png, b"IEND", &[]);
    png
}

fn ihdr(width: usize, height: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(13);
    out.extend_from_slice(&(width as u32).to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&(height as u32).to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&[8, 6, 0, 0, 0]); // 8-bit RGBA
    out
}

fn chunk(out: &mut Vec<u8>, kind: &[u8; 4], data: &[u8]) {
    out.extend_from_slice(&(data.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(kind);
    out.extend_from_slice(data);
    let mut crc_input = Vec::with_capacity(4 + data.len());
    crc_input.extend_from_slice(kind);
    crc_input.extend_from_slice(data);
    out.extend_from_slice(&crc32(&crc_input).to_be_bytes());
}

fn crc32(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut crc = u32::MAX;
    for &byte in bytes {
        crc ^= u32::from(byte);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB8_8320 & 0u32.wrapping_sub(crc & 1));
        }
    }
    !crc
}

/// DEFLATE dengan stored block (tanpa kompresi), dibungkus zlib.
fn stored_deflate(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = vec![0x78, 0x01];
    let mut position = 0;
    loop {
        let take = (data.len() - position).min(65_535);
        let last = u8::from(position + take == data.len());
        out.push(last);
        out.extend_from_slice(&(take as u16).to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&(!(take as u16)).to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&data[position..position + take]);
        position += take;
        if last == 1 {
            break;
        }
    }
    out.extend_from_slice(&adler32(data).to_be_bytes());
    out
}

fn adler32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let (mut a, mut b) = (1u32, 0u32);
    for &byte in data {
        a = (a + u32::from(byte)) % 65_521;
        b = (b + a) % 65_521;
    }
    (b << 16) | a
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::core::{Color, Size};

    #[test]
    fn png_has_valid_signature_and_ihdr() {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(Size::new(2.0, 1.0));
        frame.pixels[0..4].copy_from_slice(&[255, 0, 0, 255]);
        let png = encode(&frame);
        assert_eq!(&png[0..8], b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n");
        assert_eq!(&png[12..16], b"IHDR");
        assert_eq!(u32::from_be_bytes([png[16], png[17], png[18], png[19]]), 2);
        let _ = Color::WHITE;
    }
}
